import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strongly associated features (p < 0.05)
    p_values = [0.0015, 0.003, 0.004, 0.0055, 0.0063, 0.0071, 0.01, 0.011, 0.011, 0.012, 
                0.012, 0.019, 0.023, 0.023, 0.035, 0.036, 0.045, 0.047, 0.053, 0.067,
                0.075, 0.098, 0.1, 0.11, 0.11, 0.12, 0.14, 0.19, 0.21, 0.25, 0.26, 0.3, 0.31, 0.34, 0.36, 0.37, 0.38, 0.48, 0.49, 0.49, 0.52, 0.52, 0.52, 0.53, 0.53, 0.53, 0.54, 0.54, 0.55, 0.55, 0.55, 0.56, 0.57, 0.57, 0.57]
    
    strong_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(p_values)) if p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in strong_features]].T)
    
    # Cluster highly correlated features
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=1, linkage='average')
    distances = 1 - np.abs(corr_matrix)
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(distances)
    
    # Select top cluster as module
    module_features = [strong_features[i] for i in range(len(clusters)) if clusters[i] == 0]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (|r| > 0.6)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(module_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(module_features)):
            fid1, fid2 = module_features[i], module_features[j]
            col1, col2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) > 0.6:
                to_remove.add(fid2)
    module_features = [fid for fid in module_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # If no module found or too few features, return empty design
    if len(module_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score using first two features' loadings
    loadings = {}
    for fid in module_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])[0]
        loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    # Return design with module features (limit to 4 drivers max)
    drivers = tuple(module_features[:4])
    columns = tuple(module_features)
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=columns,
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
